name: amfx-rbob-bull-flag-research
description: amFX reproduction (02AUG23 p3): RBOB gasoline Dec 2022-Aug 2023 with bull flag context. TV chart shows native candlesticks for RB-Futures. Dashboard shows close price with breakout reference levels. LIMITATION: Diagonal trendlines (the converging flag pattern) cannot be drawn in EpochScript — only horizontal reference lines are supported. The flag target ~$2.90-3.00 and key support/resistance levels are shown as horizontal references instead.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: RBOB GASOLINE BULL FLAG (02AUG23 p3)
# =============================================================================
# RBOB gasoline with bull flag reference levels.
# Diagonal trendlines not supported — horizontal lines mark key levels.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='RBOB Gasoline: Bull Flag Breakout Levels',
    category='Price Structure',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD/gal)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RBOB Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.90, title='$2.90 Flag High', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.60, title='$2.60 Flag Low', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.20, title='$2.20 Pole Base', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)
